# Pulse 1.0.394 🚀

## 🎮 Game Hub
- 🎲 Choosing a box style (Mix, Xbox…) or ending a cover search now refreshes the shelf at once.
- 🏷️ A console box's spine shows the console's mark (Xbox sphere, PlayStation buttons, Joy-Cons) instead of its name.
- 💿 Hold the open box to eject the disc; drag it onto the console to start the game. The console is drawn for the box's console (PS5, Xbox Series, Xbox One/360, PS4, PS3, Switch, PC). Let go elsewhere and the disc goes back in.
- ⬛ Back from a game the screen no longer stays dark: the screen dimmer is cleared and the view is drawn again.

## 🏠 Home screen icons
- 🎨 Every extra app and Pulse have real icons in the line look and six Material glass colours; the icon chooser applies the choice to the home screen.
